children: On September 10, 2026, the company received a Nasdaq notice that it failed to comply with Listing Rule 5635(d) after issuing more than 20% of its pre-transaction shares at below the Minimum Price without prior shareholder approval. The company has 45 days, until October 26, 2026, to submit a plan to regain compliance, with a potential extension of up to 180 days, and its stock continues to trade on Nasdaq under XMAX.
